brief_rationale: The trajectory meets all responsibility-chain requirements: current symptom triage completed, medication safety boundary clearly established, records/orders reconciliation guided through practical verification pathway, all three follow-up owners named (ENT, spine, facial wound), executable action plan with owners and timing provided, and closure receipt verified through caregiver teach-back. No in-chain errors exist. One high-order point (HO4) is completed with meaningful trajectory impact: the doctor adapted the plan to real-world constraints by counseling on timing flexibility for spine follow-up, confirming hearing-aid-safe medication dosing, and providing contingency plans for transport barriers. Other high-order points are partial or not completed. The trajectory achieves Grade 4 Strong.
